comment: Overrides for scripts/rust-notices.py: crates the Tauri builds link that publish no usable license text. Texts in rust/ are verbatim upstream files (the reason names each source); spdx/ holds canonical SPDX texts from fetch-spdx-texts.py (license-list-data v3.29.0). Where a crate offers a choice of licenses, MIT is used. Re-check an entry when its crate's version changes.

crates.name: alloc-stdlib
crates.reason: Crate publishes no license file; BSD-3-Clause per Cargo.toml. Text is LICENSE in github.com/dropbox/rust-alloc-no-stdlib at tag 0.2.4 (identical to the file alloc-no-stdlib 2.0.4 publishes)

crates.name: dlopen2
crates.reason: Linux only. Crate publishes no license file; MIT per Cargo.toml. Text is LICENSE in github.com/OpenByteDev/dlopen2 (no tag for 0.8.x; last changed in commit d0304f3bc, 2022-06-29, before the 0.8 releases)

crates.name: siphasher
crates.reason: 1.0.3 publishes only COPYING, a pointer that names the holders (shipped as well) and 'Apache-2.0 or MIT, at your option'; MIT chosen. Text is LICENSE-MIT from siphasher 1.0.4, the next release of the same repository, which adds the texts

crates.name: unic-*
crates.reason: unic-char-property, unic-char-range, unic-common, unic-ucd-ident and unic-ucd-version publish no license file; 'MIT/Apache-2.0', MIT chosen. Text is LICENSE-MIT in github.com/open-i18n/rust-unic at tag v0.9.0 (it has no copyright line; the Authors line attributes)

crates.name: ndk
crates.reason: Android only. Crate publishes no license file; 'MIT OR Apache-2.0', MIT chosen. Text is LICENSE-MIT in github.com/rust-mobile/ndk at tag ndk-0.9.0 (no copyright line; the Authors line attributes)

crates.name: ndk-sys
crates.reason: Android only. Crate publishes no license file; 'MIT OR Apache-2.0', MIT chosen. LICENSE-MIT in github.com/rust-mobile/ndk at tag ndk-sys-0.6.0 is identical to the ndk-0.9.0 file

crates.name: selectors
crates.reason: Android only (wry -> dom_query). Crate publishes no license file; MPL-2.0 per Cargo.toml and github.com/servo/stylo. The Source Code Form line is generated from the crates.io release

crates.name: objc2*
crates.reason: macOS only: objc2, objc2-encode, objc2-exception-helper and the objc2-* framework crates publish no license file. objc2 and objc2-encode are MIT; the others offer 'Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT', MIT chosen (LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2). Upstream added the text later as LICENSE-MIT.txt (commit ee9a7ada2, 2026-03-18); that file is used

crates.name: block2
crates.reason: macOS only. Publishes no license file; MIT per Cargo.toml and LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2; text as for objc2*

crates.name: dispatch2
crates.reason: macOS only. Publishes no license file; 'Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT', MIT chosen; text as for objc2* (same repository)

crates.name: mac-notification-sys
crates.reason: macOS only. Crate publishes no license file; 'MIT/Apache-2.0', MIT chosen. Text is LICENSE-MIT in github.com/h4llow3En/mac-notification-sys at tag v0.6.15

crates.name: webview2-com*
crates.reason: Windows only: webview2-com and webview2-com-sys publish no license file; MIT per Cargo.toml. Text is LICENSE in github.com/wravery/webview2-rs (no release tags; unchanged since commit f55627c87, 2021-09-08)

extra.name: Microsoft WebView2 loader (WebView2LoaderStatic.lib)
extra.reason: webview2-com-sys 0.38.2 links WebView2LoaderStatic.lib statically on MSVC targets. The crate's x64 copy is byte-identical to the one in the Microsoft.Web.WebView2 1.0.3650.58 NuGet package (SHA-256 0659b741...); LICENSE.txt is that package's license
